name: Noshiro Anju
source:
An enigmatic girl that often pokes her nose into Sayaka's business. She seems to be Riku's senpai but he has never met her at school.

[Based on [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=613505]Getchu[/url]]
